description: This file contains helper methods for creating and retrieving comments within integration tests for the Conduit project. Specifically, it facilitates creating comments for articles, optionally creating a default user if none is specified, and verifying associated database entries.

methods.name: CreateComment
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a comment for an article based on the provided command. It optionally creates a default user if no username is provided, and retrieves the created comment from the database, throwing exceptions if expected related entities are not found.
